TimeSheet Pro - User Guide: Submitting a Weekly Timesheet

Step 1. Log in with your company email and password. If this is your
first time, click "Forgot password" to set one.

Step 2. Click "New Timesheet" and select the week you want to report.
Enter the hours worked for each project on each day of the week.

Step 3. If you worked overtime, check the "Overtime" box next to the
relevant entry and enter the number of overtime hours separately.

Step 4. Review your entries for accuracy, then click "Submit for
Approval." You must submit your timesheet by 5:00 PM every Friday.

Step 5. Your manager will review and approve or reject the timesheet. If
the system displays an error during submission, contact IT support with
the error code shown on screen.

Note: You cannot edit a timesheet after it has been approved. If you find
a mistake afterward, submit a correction request through the same menu.
